frame: ICRS equatorial, right-handed cartesian; +x towards (RA 0h, Dec 0), +z towards Dec +90
epoch: J2000.0 — positions are AT-HYG x0/y0/z0, the epoch-2000 cartesian columns, used verbatim

secondarySources.name: HYG v4.1 — variability and multiplicity flags, joined on HIP then HD
NASA Exoplanet Archive pscomppars (TAP sync) — exoplanet host flag

globalIndexSpace.description: l0 occupies [0, l0Count); l1 occupies [l0Count, l0Count + l1Count). L2 chunks are disjoint from both and are not part of this space.

dequantization.magnitude: mag = magu / 16 - 2    (apparent V/VT magnitude; magu = round((mag + 2) * 16); step 0.0625 mag; representable range -2.000 .. +13.938)
dequantization.colourIndex: ci = ciu / 40 - 0.5    (Johnson B-V; ciu = round((ci + 0.5) * 40); step 0.025; representable range -0.500 .. +5.875)
dequantization.absoluteMagnitude: absmag = mag - 5 * (log10(sqrt(x*x + y*y + z*z)) - 1)   — not stored; derive it from the dequantized mag and the position
dequantization.positionL0L1: float32 parsecs, stored verbatim — no quantization applied
dequantization.positionL2: x_pc = x_i16 * shell.scale, where shell.scale = shell.radiusPc / 32767 and a star`s shell is the manifest entry whose [start, start + count) index range contains it

flags.bit1 (0x02): has-exoplanet — host matched a NASA Exoplanet Archive pscomppars row
flags.bit2 (0x04): is-variable — HYG v4.1 `var` (variable-star designation) is non-empty for the HIP/HD-matched row
flags.bit3 (0x08): is-multiple — HYG v4.1 `base` non-empty or `comp` > 1 for the HIP/HD-matched row
flags.bit4 (0x10): ci-was-defaulted — AT-HYG `ci` was empty; the stored value is the solar default 0.65
flags.bit6 (0x40): absmag-missing — AT-HYG `absmag` was empty (derive it from mag + distance instead)
flags.bit7 (0x80): ci-from-hyg — AT-HYG had no colour index, so it was back-filled from HYG v4.1 (bit4 is then clear)
